pick.headline: Reflagged tanker Bridgeton hits a mine in the Gulf's first US convoy

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 142, 24 July 1987
evidence.snippet: V. 24 Jul 87 24 July Middle East and South Asia Review LD241328 [Editorial Report] Gulf Conflict Following reports that the U.S.-flagged Kuwaiti tanker Bridgeton hit a mine 24 July, IRNA cited Iranian Prime Minis- ter Mir Hoseyn Musavi’s statement that the explosion hit U.S. credibility and dealt an “irreparable blow” to U.S. prestige. “U.S. schemes were foiled by invisible hand…

alternates.headline: Russia's central bank withdraws pre-1993 ruble notes

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Central Eurasia, No. 141, 26 July 1993
evidence.snippet: …and bank notes of the Bank of Russia of 1961-1992 issue throughout the Russian Federation starting from midnight on 25 July 1993. From 26 July 1993, state treasury notes of the USSR of 1961 issue of one, three, and five ruble denominations, notes of the State Bank of the USSR of 1961-1992 issue of one, three, five, 10, 25, 50, 100, 200, 500, and 1,000 ruble denominations, and bank notes of the Bank of Russia of 1992 issue of 5,000 and 10,000…
